turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - nlo_shg_train.csv: 200 crystalline materials, columns `formula`,
    `poscar` (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format) and `shg` (the
    largest SHG tensor component |d_ij|, in pm/V).
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

Using the training data, predict which candidates have the LARGEST SHG
tensor component |d_ij| (pm/V), then select the 5 best candidates from the
pool.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The training set shows that the largest \(|d_{ij}|\) values arise from non-centrosymmetric structures that combine (i) tetrahedral (zincblende/chalcopyrite/wurtzite-derived) or lone-pair-containing motifs with (ii) the most polarizable anions (Te \(\gg\) Se \(\gg\) S) and cations (In, Cd, Ga, Ge, heavy pnictogens). Concrete high-value analogues are:

- ZnGa\(_2\)Te\(_4\)/CdGa\(_2\)Te\(_4\) (\(\approx 92\)),
- ZnIn\(_3\)AsSe\(_4\) (\(55.7\)),
- K\(_{14}\)Nb\(_2\)As\(_8\) (\(68.8\)),
- ZnSiP\(_2\) (\(51\)) / ZnSnP\(_2\) (\(84\)),
- Ba\(_2\)Te\(_6\) (\(83\)) and GeTePb\(_2\)Se\(_2\) (\(302\)).

Applying the same chemical and structural filters to the pool immediately isolates five candidates whose lattices, stoichiometries and local coordination match the above families while substituting still-heavier or more polarizable atoms:

- c073 (CdIn\(_3\)AsTe\(_4\)) is the Te/Cd analogue of the \(55.7\) compound and of the \(92\)-pm/V tellurides; the substitution is expected to produce the single largest response.
- c079 (Ba\(_4\)Ge\(_2\)Te\(_5\)Se\(_3\)) is Te-rich and contains a stereochemically active Ge lone pair, placing it next to Ba\(_2\)Te\(_6\) and the record Ge–Te–Se phase.
- c090 (K\(_{14}\)Ta\(_2\)As\(_8\)) is isostructural with the \(68.8\) niobium compound (identical lattice parameters), so a comparable tensor component is expected.
- c030 (CdSiP\(_2\)) is the Cd analogue of ZnSiP\(_2\) (\(51\)); the more polarizable Cd cation systematically raises \(|d_{ij}|\) in every II–IV–V\(_2\) pair in the training set.
- c055 (AlGaAs wurtzite superlattice) is the hexagonal counterpart of GaP (\(68\)) / AlSb (\(54\)); the arsenide and the polar [111] stacking push the value above the phosphide analogues.

All other pool entries are either centrosymmetric-derived, contain only lighter chalcogens, or belong to structure types whose training-set members lie well below \(50\) pm/V.

Final: c073, c079, c090, c030, c055
